description: UI shell architecture overhaul: pointer-ops manager, per-area tab managers (topbar/left/right), modal+tooltip manager with panic-guarded panels; floating tool windows migrate into the right-sidebar inspector; tool-descriptions sidebar replaced by tooltips; P0 Phase 0 = gardener_ui_system terrain crash fix + viewport path-point selection fix (eager track-list load)
alignment: P0 UX + P0 STABILITY (user-directed 2026-07-24 in-app findings); user-owned UX pillar per roadmap 2026-07-14
notes: 2026-07-24: created from live user testing — (1) cannot select/manipulate existing path points (ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: viewport_pick track_to_open gate requires path_state.tracks, which only loads while the Data window Paths tab renders; fix = eager-load on petal change); (2) terrain tools crash (gardener_ui_system panic → egui pass poisoned, exit 101; H-C1 = proposals-only terrain_json on config-less petal); (3) always-open tool-descriptions sidebar → tooltips; (4) manager decoupling directive (pointer / per-area tabs / modal).

Absorbs ux_interaction_hardening FR-1..FR-4 (incl. FR-3 gimbal damping — absorbed, not dropped); supersedes tool_inspector_ux Phases 2-6 and reworks its Phase 1 left panel; carries terrain_editor_overhaul's residual viewport-selection acceptance; unblocks pen_curve_tool in-app verification.

5 open questions filed in spec §Open questions await user ratification (Q-1 left rail removal, Q-2 right-sidebar tabs, Q-3 single-click edit entry, Q-4 Data/Map windows stay floating, Q-5 panic-guard UX); Phase 0 is ratification-independent.
